- **Done checks (at most 3, each failing on partial work):**
  1. A seat starts only on a probe under 60 minutes old (F-040, MD-002). Before every seat turn (seat_turn and turn) the facilitator checks the age of the last probe; at 60 minutes or more it probes again first; if it cannot probe (the probe raises or its evidence cannot be written) the seat is refused with exit 2 and a named reason, before any backend call. The seat's MOB.md entry and events line cite the probe's taken_at. ZOMBIES: Z (the card-start probe is the only one: no second probe before seat 1), O (one seat on a fresh probe: no re-probe), M (several seats, the third past 60 minutes: one re-probe, before it), B (exactly 60 minutes is stale, 59 minutes 59 seconds is fresh), E (probing fails: refused, no backend call, never staffed on the stale probe), I (every seat's cited probe is under 60 minutes old at its start). N/A: S, covered by the existing probe tests
  2. Seats rotate least-recently-used from a tracked seat-use history, and the record says why (MD-002, D163, D164). For each seat the gate picks, among the models available on the fresh probe (enabled, probe ok), the one whose last seating is oldest; a Claude seat is refused (exit 2, naming role, context and the older available model to use instead) only when another available model has waited longer; Claude starts its own least-recently-used turn, and any turn while no other model is available. The history is .mob/records/seat-use.jsonl, tracked and append-only: the facilitator copies each seat's events.jsonl line (model, role, card, time, probe taken_at) into it at gate_seat after the backend call is chosen, a seat has no write path to it, it is committed with each seating commit or the card commit, never rewritten or deleted, and the gate computes the order from it so that rotation and the count of rosters that are all-Claude while another model had quota can be recomputed from git alone. Each Claude seat's entry in .mob/records/NNN.json keeps quota_reason, built from the probe in force (taken_at plus each model's availability evidence) and the history entry that justified the pick, never typed by a seat; an unread probe result is never read as no quota. A Claude seat launches the model the probe used (the pinned probe_model key), not whichever key is first in its models. ZOMBIES: Z (no history file: every available model is equally old, the first seat is not refused, and no Claude refusal happens on an empty history; no Claude seat in the roster: no refusal and no quota_reason), O (one Claude seat whose model is the oldest available: starts, reason cites the probe and the history line), M (a mixed roster over several seats: seats follow the order of last use, each Claude seat's quota_reason cites its own probe across a re-probe), B (Claude and one other model tie on last use: the tie breaks by a fixed order and never refuses both; exactly one other available model older than Claude refuses Claude; a model never used counts as oldest; a backend disabled in backends.json counts as unavailable and does not make Claude wait), E (a non-Claude backend missing from the probe results, or a result without ok, is refused as unread, never taken as no quota; the history file missing a line it should hold, unreadable, or not append-only (an earlier line changed) is refused before any backend call, exit 2; a history line whose evidence fails to write is refused for a mixed roster as well as an all-Claude one, exit 2; TrueMobbing: a member added mid-card, including a Claude member, votes at once at the whole-team checkpoint of the cycle it joined and the test asserts that joiner's own vote, not only a count of another model's seats (review finding F2); the seat's launched Claude model equals the probe's model, asserted by a test that reorders claude's models and adds a "default" key and sees both the seat and the probe follow the pin (review finding F3)), I (the refusal text names the seat and the older available model; exit 2; the loop stops as a gate refusal; the history gains exactly one line per seat started and none for a refused seat; an auditor recomputes the order and the all-Claude-while-others-had-quota count from seat-use.jsonl in git, target 0). N/A: S, covered by the existing claude-only and quota tests, which stay as the proof that an all-Claude roster is still refused at card start while another model has quota
  3. The probe model is pinned (MD-002). Each enabled backend in core/backends.json names probe_model, a key of its own models; probe_backend uses it (not the first dict entry) and the probe result records the model; a missing or unknown pin refuses the card at start (exit 2, naming the backend), and probe_backend called directly with an unusable pin (not a string, or not a key of the backend's models) returns a failed probe and launches nothing, with no fall back to the first model (review finding F1). ZOMBIES: Z (an enabled backend without probe_model is refused by name), O (one backend pinned, the model in its result), M (all five pinned, each result carries its model), B (a pin that is not a key of models is refused; reordering models does not change the probe model), E (a disabled backend needs no pin; probe_backend with a missing, non-string or unknown pin returns a failed probe and starts no backend process), I (the shipped backends.json passes). N/A: S, covered by the existing probe tests
